### Be Careful How You Listen
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-daily-devotion-mar-1-2011-11646417.html
Passage: Exodus 7:14
Points:
- The easiest time to develop spiritual hardness is while hearing God's Word with an indifferent attitude.
- Just as sunlight softens wax but hardens clay, Scripture impacts people according to how they receive it.
- Repeatedly resisting correction and rejecting truth puts a person on a path toward destruction.
- Pharaoh witnessed extraordinary signs—including the Nile turned to blood—yet persistently refused to submit.
- God permits people to make their own choices, ultimately confirming them in their stubborn resolve.
